heroSubtitle: FDS invites talented people to join our smart and experienced team to deliver outstanding IT solutions for global clients.
modalInvite: FDS invites talented people to join our smart and experienced team to deliver outstanding IT solutions for the clients.
bodyResponsibilities: Responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of computer applications, web applications, and mobile applications. You will also be expected to develop, maintain and enhance iOS / Android applications as part of our core product suite.
bodyRequirements: Candidates should possess a University degree in Computer Science or equivalent, especially in the fields of Computer & Information Sciences, Computing, or Information System Management. Education Level (pursuing / obtained) in Master, Bachelor or Postgraduate Diploma is required. Fresh graduates are welcomed.
bodySkills: Solid experience in HTML, JavaScript, Java, .NET, SQL, OOP, MVC and Windows environment is essential. Experienced in web-based application development and mobile application development is a definite advantage. Proficiency in Objective-C/Swift and iOS SDK / Android or Java is expected. Candidates should demonstrate strong analytical and problem solving skills, along with good written and spoken English and Chinese communication skills. Applicants must be self-motivated, able to work independently and under pressure.
bodyBenefits: We offer a five-day work week and a professional working environment. Occasional overseas travel may be required. Comprehensive Medical Insurance and a Performance Bonus are provided. Our special leave policy includes Birthday Leave, Marriage Leave, and Paternity Leave.
